scenario.name: Pedestrian emerging from behind a parked vehicle
scenario.description: A pedestrian, child or cyclist steps out from behind a parked van or bus away from a crossing, where pedestrians are dense

events.description: Steers onto the sidewalk at low speed

triggers.condition: Parked vans, buses, hedges or walls hiding a crossing or a corner
People crossing away from crossings, or at the kerb looking at a phone

goals.statement: Decelerate at least as much as needed to avoid a collision the planned trajectory avoids
Avoid unintended lateral motion out of the planned path
Do not enter an intersection, roundabout or crosswalk against right of way

scenario.meant: slow enough to stop for anyone emerging
scenario.pass: The vehicle's speed near the occlusion lets it stop for a road user emerging at the assumed speed; no contact, and no swerve out of the drivable area to avoid one
